subject: Re: GreenGrid latency incident — proposed relief and credits
messages:
From: Sarah Green <sarah.green@greengrid.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, GreenGrid Support <support@greengrid.ai>
Cc: procurement@greengrid.ai
Date: Fri, 11 Jul 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Latency spike during migration window — production impact

Hi Lauren,

We experienced a significant latency regression in our production workloads during your scheduled migration window yesterday (Jul 10, 22:00–23:30 UTC). Between 22:15 and 22:55 UTC our inference p95 jumped from ~120ms to ~2.4s and a subset of batch requests returned 500s intermittently. This spiked error rates and caused several downstream jobs to fail.

Our engineering team attached a short timeline and a sample of service logs (attached). This impacted two mission-critical pipelines and resulted in delayed processing for ~45k inference calls. We need to understand root cause and would like to discuss remediation and compensation (credits or trial extension) under our contract.

Please advise next steps and an estimated timeline for a formal credit proposal. We are on a monthly invoice cadence; procurement also needs the ETA for any invoice offsets.

—
Sarah Green
Director, Platform Engineering
GreenGrid Analytics
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Green <sarah.green@greengrid.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Support <support@greengrid.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Jul 2025 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Latency spike during migration window — production impact

Hi Sarah — thanks for flagging this and for the logs. I’m really sorry you hit that; this is not the SLA experience we aim to deliver.

Ben (CS) — can you validate the impacted window and provide an impact estimate (tokens/requests affected) and a recommended remediation package (credit percentage, trial extension, any token top-up)?

I’ll coordinate with Finance to confirm what we can authorize quickly so we can get a formal offer to GreenGrid this week.

Lauren Bishop
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Sarah Green <sarah.green@greengrid.ai>
Cc: Support <support@greengrid.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Jul 2025 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Latency spike during migration window — production impact

Hi all — I reviewed the logs and correlated infra traces. Key points: 
- Confirmed latency spike 2025-07-10T22:15:00Z–2025-07-10T22:55:00Z.
- Affected requests: ~45,300 inference calls (as Sarah reported).
- Error type: intermittent 500s from the model worker pool during a rolling kernel update; rollback was initiated at 22:50 UTC.

Proposed remediation package (internal recommendation):
- Service credit: 25% of the affected billing period (July cycle) applied as invoice credit.
- Trial extension: +30 days to your trial/paid eval for the same seat(s).
- Goodwill token top-up: 50k tokens promotional credit to help cover reprocessing.

I’m attaching a short incident timeline and the extracted service log snippet we used for the analysis.

If Finance can approve, we can send a formal offer to GreenGrid. If Sarah would prefer a different split (e.g., higher token credit in lieu of percent rebate), we can adjust.

—
Ben Carter
Customer Success
Redwood Inference
Attachment: incident-timeline-2025-07-11.pdf
Attachment: service-log-2025-07-11.txt
From: Sarah Green <sarah.green@greengrid.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, procurement@greengrid.ai
Date: Fri, 11 Jul 2025 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Latency spike during migration window — production impact

Thanks, Ben — that matches our numbers. 

Procurement asked whether the 25% would be applied as a credit to the July invoice or as a one-time invoice offset. Also curious whether the token top-up can be applied as an account credit we can use programmatically (not a manual code).

If you can get Finance sign-off today, we’ll route the invoice accordingly. Also please include the formal incident summary and a point of contact for recurring prevention steps.

—
Sarah
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Jul 2025 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GreenGrid latency incident — proposed relief and credits

Lauren / Ben — Finance reviewed Ben’s recommended package. Approved items: 
- 25% service credit applied against the July invoice as an invoice credit (system-generated).
- 30-day trial extension applied to the account and reflected in billing metadata.
- Promotional token credit: 50,000 tokens — approved as an account credit (automatable).

Note: Anything beyond this (larger refunds, multi-month credits) needs Exec sign-off. For compliance, I’ve attached the approval stub and we’ll log the credit against deal GG-2025-07-001.

I’ll also create a finance ticket to ensure the offset appears on the next invoice.

—
Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Finance Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Green <sarah.green@greengrid.ai>, procurement@greengrid.ai
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 13 Jul 2025 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Latency spike during migration window — production impact

Hi Sarah — thanks again for your patience while we worked this through. Per our internal approvals, here’s the formal offer we can apply to GreenGrid Analytics: 

- 25% service credit applied as an invoice credit to your July 2025 billing cycle (will appear on next invoice).
- 30-day extension of your trial/paid eval window for the affected seats (applied automatically).
- 50,000 promotional tokens applied as an account credit you can consume programmatically.

I’ve attached the formal incident timeline and the log excerpt used for the assessment. Next steps: 
1) Procurement: confirm you want the credit applied to the July invoice or as a one-time offset (we will default to invoice credit unless you advise otherwise).
2) Ben: follow up with a short post-incident checklist and POC for runbook updates.
3) Stephanie / Finance: please confirm when the credit has been posted.

If that package works, I’ll circulate the short confirmation letter and close this ticket. Apologies again for the disruption — we’ll share remediation actions and timing in the follow-up postmortem.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachment: incident-timeline-2025-07-11.pdf
Attachment: service-log-2025-07-11.txt
